name: theme
title: dfdl theme
author: Dylan Fernandez de Lara
description: Tokens, the Tailwind v4 mapping and motion utilities, and cn configured with the dfdl vocabulary. Install this before any component.
docs: New app: replace the contents of your global CSS with @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "../styles/dfdl/tokens.css"; @import "../styles/dfdl/theme.css"; @import "../styles/dfdl/base.css"; (shadcn init's own theme block would override the theme). Existing app: import tokens.css and theme.css after tailwindcss and before your own @theme, and skip base.css to keep your page defaults. Load Lora with next/font as --font-lora. Set the accent on <html data-accent="ember"> or "indigo".
